cohort: Women delivering at Obstetric Unit 2 of D. Ruth K. M. Pfau Civil Hospital, Karachi, Pakistan from August 1, 2022 to January 31, 2023, with a 1st-trimester weight record.
finding: Maternal obesity in early pregnancy is strongly associated with several pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the predominant mode of delivery (55.7%) and was significantly associated with high BMI.
followup_time: Through the postpartum period (exact duration not specified)
